summary: Super League Enterprise, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a waiver and release agreement with Aegis Capital Corp. The company paid $0.7 million on July 30, 2026, to waive rights of first refusal from prior engagement agreements, and will pay $0.3 million before any future financing to waive tail fees. The agreement removes potential obstacles for future financings but involves no securities transaction. It is a routine contractual arrangement, not a special situation.
